Fjerklædt startjæger med hurtige bid. Bi: Feather starter wey get quick bites. Bite from side or back for the most damage.
Kort undvigelse; dit næste bid fra siden: Short dodge; your next bite from side or back go do +# % damage for # sec.
Lille startjæger med de hurtigste bid. H: Small starter wey get the fastest bites. E health small pass the bigger hunters.
Kort kløspring; du er beskyttet, mens du: Short claw leap; you dey protected while you dey jump.
Balanceret jæger med god fart og solide: Balanced hunter wey get good speed and strong bites. Safe pick for every level.
Beskyttet spring; kløerne rammer hvert d: Protected jump; the claws go hit each animal for road once.
Hurtig planteæder med en tyk skalle. Hov: Fast plant eater wey get thick skull. Headbutt dey keep small animals far.
Butt forward and push the animal wey you hit back.
Kødæder med tunge bid og god fart. Længe: Meat eater wey get heavy bites and good speed. E dey rest pass raptors between bites.
Storm frem og skad alt, du rammer; du ka: Charge forward and damage anything wey you jam; dem fit still hit you.
Pansret planteæder. Dit angreb er et hal: Armoured plant eater. Your attack na tail swipe wey go round you full.
The smallest species, small bites and small health. Comot body from big animals.
Smut et kort stykke frem og væk fra fare: Dash small forward and comot from danger.
Den hurtigste art. Spiser både planter o: The fastest species. E dey chop both plants and meat, but e bite weak.
Kort sprint væk fra fare; giver ingen be: Short sprint from danger; e no dey give protection.
Fanger fisk ved stimer og spiser også kø: E dey catch fish for shoals and e still dey chop meat. E dey swim small faster for deep water.
Fang fisk fra en stime, eller ram bytte: Catch fish from shoal, or strike prey wey dey near.
Krokodilleslægt med kraftige, langsomme: Crocodile family wey get strong, slow bites. E fast well well for deep water pass for land.
Kort fremstød med åbent gab; giver ingen: Short lunge with open mouth; e no dey give protection.
Tung planteæder med # % panser forfra. R: Heavy plant eater wey get # % armour for front. The back no get protection.
Storm frem med hornene; stærk forfra, så: Charge forward with your horns; strong for front, weak for back.
Det største rovdyr med mest liv. Langsom: The biggest predator wey get the most health. Slow bites wey dey crush.
Brøl og skræm almindelige dyr i nærheden: Roar make nearby normal animals fear; bosses no dey fear.
